title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Care Desk Guidance: Courtesy and In-Error Fee Reversals
content:
**Courtesy reversal of a late fee.** A late fee on a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account may be reversed as a courtesy (reversal reason: courtesy waiver) when all of the following hold:

1. the number of courtesy reversals on the account, by transaction date in the rolling 12 calendar months ending on the handling date, is below the card's courtesy allowance;
2. the on-time streak counted from the statement immediately before the missed statement reaches the card's required number of on-time statements; the streak is the number of consecutive statements, counted backward, for which the payments credited on or after the statement date and on or before the payment due date add up to at least the minimum payment due, a statement with a minimum payment due of 0.00 counting as on time;
3. *(retired)* the clause "and payments credited since the missed due date add up to at least the missed minimum payment due" is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis for courtesy reversals of late fees.

**Fees outside the courtesy.** Only late fees are reversed as a courtesy; returned payment, annual, expedited replacement and foreign transaction fees are not.

**Fees assessed in error.** Any fee assessed contrary to the Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards terms (for example a late fee on a minimum that was met on time, a fee above the minimum payment due, or both a late fee and a returned payment fee for one missed payment) is reversed in full with the reversal reason assessed in error, does not count toward the courtesy allowance, and needs no on-time history.

**Condition on any reversal.** The fee being reversed has not been reversed before: the account's transaction records show no earlier fee reversal pointing to the same fee.

**Amount of a reversal.** *(retired)* The clause "A reversal always equals the full amount of the fee reversed and points to it by its transaction reference; partial reversals are not made" is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis for reversal amounts.

## Judgement table (courtesy reversal of a late fee)

| Courtesy reversals in the rolling 12 months | On-time streak before the missed statement | Courtesy allowance and on-time tests |
|---|---|---|
| below the card's allowance | reaches the required number | met |
| at the card's allowance | reaches the required number | not met |
| below the card's allowance | short of the required number | not met |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- A Store Card account with an allowance of 1 already had one courtesy reversal 5 months ago: the count equals the allowance, so no courtesy reversal is made.
- A late fee assessed although the minimum was credited on the due date is reversed in full as assessed in error, whatever the courtesy count or the on-time history.
- A request to reverse a returned payment fee as a courtesy: only late fees are reversed as a courtesy.
